6778315973.releaseNotes:
A whole new ForgeIt.

• New look: a bold red, black and white design on every screen, and a new app icon.
• Meet Forgie, your editing buddy. It walks around the app, shares tips, cheers your edits and roasts the odd slip. Pick its look, personality and roast level, or tuck it away.
• Redesigned editor: turn the tool dial to switch tools, paint at any zoom, and use the brush, eraser and size rail beside your photo.
• New home screen with quick ways into every tool and your projects.
• Search finds tools, projects, text styles and settings instantly, even with typos.
• Redesigned Settings: appearance, haptics, notification sound, export format and translation language, plus a Help Center.
• Live tutorials that show each tool in the real editor, and a new welcome tour.
• Smooth new page animations.
• Remove Background is still always free.
• Bug fixes and performance improvements.
6778315973.description:
Change the words in any photo and keep its look. ForgeIt reads the text in your picture, you type something new, and it puts the new words back in the same place and style, as if they had always been there.

Fix a typo on a poster, update a price or a date, rewrite a caption, translate a sign, or clear out what you don't want. Six tools, one simple editor.

CHANGE TEXT IN ANY PHOTO
• Text recognition (OCR) finds every line for you. Tap a line, or paint over any text to select it
• Manual: type new words in the same style, free and instant. Auto Match Original copies the look of the text around it
• Auto: ForgeIt AI paints the new words into the photo to match its font, texture and lighting
• Style every detail: fonts, 7 weights, italic, underline, color, gradient, outline, shadow, shine, a backing plate, per-letter colors, spacing, alignment and opacity
• The old words are cleared and the background filled in, so nothing shows through
• Zoom up to 5x, hold Before to compare, and undo or redo any step

FIVE MORE TOOLS
• Replace Image: paint over a picture, logo or element and swap it for another
• Remove Object: paint over what you don't want and it's gone
• Remove Background: cut out your subject on your device, then keep it transparent (PNG) or put it on a color, a blur or a new photo. Always free
• Add Text: place text, stickers and pictures, then move, resize and style each one. 50 text style presets to start from
• Image Translator: translate every line of text in a photo into 23 languages and set it back where it was, on your device (iOS 26 or later, with Apple Intelligence)

MADE TO BE EASY
• Turn the tool dial to switch between the six tools
• Live tutorials show each tool in the real editor
• Your projects and edit history are saved, and Search finds any tool, project, style or setting
• Meet Forgie, an optional editing buddy with tips (and the odd friendly roast)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account needed. Text recognition, background removal and translation run on your iPhone or iPad. When you choose a ForgeIt AI edit, your photo is uploaded securely to make it, as our Privacy Policy explains.

GREAT FOR
• Posters, flyers, menus and price tags
• Social posts, memes, quotes and captions
• Mockups, collages and design drafts
• Translating signs, notes and labels

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open a photo or screenshot
2. Pick a tool and tap or paint what to change
3. Type, swap, erase or translate
4. Save as PNG or JPEG and share

FORGEIT PRO
• Save and share at full resolution, with no ads
• All 50 text style presets
• Unlimited edit history
• Free ForgeIt AI credits included, with credit packs any time
• Every future Pro feature

Free: Manual text edits, Add Text, Remove Background and translation, with exports up to 1080 px. Choose a subscription or a one-time lifetime unlock for Pro. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

RESPONSIBLE USE
ForgeIt is made for creative, educational, entertainment, design and personal use. You are responsible for how you create, share and use your edited images. ForgeIt does not support fraud, impersonation, misinformation, forgery, document falsification or any unlawful activity. Please follow all applicable laws and platform policies.

Terms of Use: https://redizeuz.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://redizeuz.com/privacy

6834076393.description:
Most screen time tools count minutes. Minutes say nothing about whether the time was worth it.

Good Terms puts a five-second check-in in front of the apps you choose to limit. Before you go in, it asks how you feel and what you are looking for. If you are still there when your time runs out, it asks how you feel now, and whether you found it.

Over time you see which sessions leave you better off and which leave you worse, in your own data.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose the apps you want a pause in front of: two for free, or any number and whole categories with Plus.
• Open one and you get a check-in: a mood from Low to Great, and what you are hoping to find.
• Unlock just that app for 5, 15 or 30 minutes.
• Still there when time is up? One more question: how do you feel now?

INSIGHTS FROM YOUR OWN SESSIONS
• Which apps lift your mood and which drain it.
• A grid of every app by time of day, so you can see that the late-night scroll is the one that costs you.
• How often you found what you came for.
• A one-line reminder at each check-in, drawn from your most recent sessions: "Your last 18 sessions here at this time of day ended 1.9 lower on average."
• Nothing is shown until it rests on at least 10 completed sessions.

GENTLE OR FIRM
• Gentle: you can always get in after a check-in, and you can skip it.
• Firm: a daily budget you set in advance, no skipping, and one emergency pass a week.

KIND, NOT STRICT
Good Terms asks and reflects back. It never scolds, and every limit is one you set and can change.

A SKY THAT FOLLOWS YOUR DAY
The app is a paper landscape that changes with the clock: a morning sun, a clear midday, a dusky evening and a night sky. Your mood moves the sun.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in.
• No ads and no tracking.
• Your check-ins are stored on your device. Nothing is sent to us.
• If you join a family, only your weekly totals are shared, through your own iCloud.
• Delete your check-in history at any time, in Limits.
• Good Terms uses Apple's Screen Time to lock the apps you choose. It never sees what you do inside any app.

FOR FAMILIES
• Set Good Terms up on a child's phone with a parent's approval, and keep the limits behind a parent code.
• Together shows each person's week: minutes unlocked, and how often they moved on when time ran out. A parent's numbers are there too.
• Send a cheer when someone does well.
• Moods stay private unless someone chooses to share theirs.

GOOD TERMS PLUS
Good Terms is free for two apps. Plus covers as many apps as you like and whole categories, lets you start a family, and shows each other's week and cheers. One purchase covers your Family Sharing group. Monthly, yearly or a one-time purchase. Subscriptions renew until cancelled in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://hirocloud.com/good-terms/privacy

Good Terms is not a medical product and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

Requires iOS 26 or later and Screen Time access.

6822308678.releaseNotes: This update brings performance, stability and reliability improvements across Ringo, including smoother mode launches, refined Quick Set and chapter progression, improved sound and haptic handling, and general interface and VoiceOver polish.
6822308678.description:
A little water toy. A whole ocean of puzzles.

Ringo brings the classic water-ring toy to your iPhone and iPad. Press the two water jets to lift colourful hoops, steer them through the current, then let them settle over the pegs. A gentle correction can make all the difference.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Play the first 30 Classic tides free. Unlock all 2,000 tides across 80 chapters with Ringo Pro, an optional one-time purchase. Choose any tide with Pro, or follow the journey through obstacles, drifting pegs and floating targets. Return to earn more stars by improving your time and using fewer bursts.

FIND YOUR FAVOURITE WAY TO PLAY
• Quick Sets: three short rounds with a choice of focus.
• Time Attack: land as many rings as you can in 60 seconds.
• Zen: keep the rings flowing without a clock.
• Precision: twelve trials with a limited number of bursts.
• Daily Tide: a shared daily puzzle with your best saved on this device.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Choose Bubble Poles, Hover Pods or Crystal Spires. Enjoy underwater scenery, water sounds and haptic feedback. Turn on optional tilt and shake controls, or play entirely with the two buttons.

No ads. No subscription. No app account required. Play offline, with progress and preferences saved on each device. An internet connection is needed to purchase, restore or redeem Ringo Pro. Progress does not sync between devices.

Made for iPhone and iPad, with portrait and landscape play on iPad.

Press, steer, release — and watch the rings find their place.

6827587342.releaseNotes:
• Resume unfinished flashcard rounds directly from Flash cards, even when no priority reviews are due.
• Tapping the active tab now returns cleanly to the root screen across Learn, Flash cards and Translate.
• Improved contrast for custom study cards without tone numbers when Tone colours is enabled.
• Better spacing for spoken English numbers and punctuation in Translate, plus stronger local data protection for saved history and study sets.
• General stability, navigation and bilingual localisation improvements.
6827587342.description:
Learn useful Mandarin from English, or practise English with Mandarin support. Ni Hao Bolo brings a small everyday library, simple flash cards and English Chinese translation together in one calm app.

START WITH EVERYDAY LANGUAGE
Explore words and phrases across practical topics: question words, first words, numbers, meeting people, food and shopping, time and places, and conversation help. Search in English, Chinese or Pinyin.

READ IN THE WAY THAT SUITS YOU
Choose Chinese characters with Pinyin, characters only with Pinyin available to reveal, or Pinyin only. Optional tone colours help distinguish written tones. Hear words and phrases using available system voices, with adjustable speaking speed.

PRACTISE WITHOUT PRESSURE
Reveal an answer, choose Known or Practise again, and undo a choice whenever needed. Today’s Recall brings missed cards and due reviews together. Random 15 offers a short mixed round. There are no streaks, leaderboards or mastery scores.

TRANSLATE BEYOND THE LIBRARY
Type, paste or speak English or Mandarin. Copy a result, show it full screen, see a Pinyin reading aid and revisit recent translations in local history. Translation requires iOS 18 or later and supported Apple language models. Translation, speech recognition and playback voices may need separate system downloads. Automatic translations and Pinyin readings can need checking.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose Jade Tea or Apricot, follow your device’s appearance or select Light or Dark, and adjust reading and audio preferences. Add the Say it today Home Screen widget for a daily phrase.

Learning text, flash cards and saved choices work offline. Translation and audio depend on the required system assets being available. No account, advertising or tracking. Learning choices and translation history stay on your device.

6751436384.releaseNotes: New: Reminders! Get a quiet heads-up before your period, a nudge if it’s late, or a reminder to log your symptoms. You choose how often and what time. You can also write your own notification text, like “My parcel is on the way”, so only you know what it means. No cringy tips, no weird messages, no pushy upgrade prompts. Reminders are free, and so is logging. Still private, still offline, still no account.
6751436384.description:
Your cycle, logged deeply with details. Owned completely.

Petals is a private period tracker that keeps your data on your phone, ALWAYS. No internet needed. No account. No one can see your information, ever.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE.

Most period apps send your personal health information to their servers. Petals doesn't. Everything you log stays on your iPhone. There are no Petals servers. Your cycle is yours, and only YOURS.

SWITCH FROM ANY APP IN SECONDS.

Already tracking in Apple Health, Flo, or Clue? Bring your full menstrual history into Petals in one tap. You can import your period dates, flow, spotting and symptoms data directly from Apple Health and add it to your Petals timeline. No manual re-entry, no starting from scratch. Import once, or repeat anytime to pull in new data. Your Apple Health data stays exactly where it is. Petals just reads it.

TRACK 52 SIGNALS. UNDERSTAND YOUR BODY.

- Period & flow: mark period days, log how heavy your flow is, blood colour, clots and spotting

- Body signals: cramps, discharge, headaches, nausea, acne, brain fog, breast tenderness and more

- Lifestyle:  stress, sleep, travel, workouts, caffeine and more

- Vitals:  temperature, blood pressure, heart rate, weight and more

- Well-being:  mood, energy, cravings, focus, self-care and more

For each signal, you can add details like how bad it is, where it hurts, and what time it happened. Nothing gets missed.

REMINDERS THAT STAY QUIET.
Many period apps send cringy tips and weird messages you never asked for. Petals doesn’t. You choose what to be reminded about:

- Upcoming period: get a period reminder on the first expected day or a few days before
- Late period: a gentle nudge if your period is later than expected
- Signal logging: a reminder to log how you feel

Pick the time. Pick how often. Turn any reminder off anytime. Reminders are free and work offline.

WRITE YOUR OWN NOTIFICATION MESSAGE.
Don’t want family, friends, or coworkers to see “period reminder” on your screen?  Write your own, like “My parcel is on the way”. Your lock screen shows only your words. Only you will know what it means.

PREDICTIONS THAT LEARN FROM YOU
Petals predicts your next period using your own cycle history; not an average from someone else's data. You can also set your own cycle length manually if you prefer. Your body, your rules.

SIMPLE TO USE. NOT OVERWHELMING
Petals is designed to be simple, not overwhelming. Pick the signals you're feeling, add the details, and you're done in under a minute. Clean design, no clutter.

FIND ANY LOG IN SECONDS.
Every signal you've ever logged is saved in a searchable list. Tap any entry to see the full details.  Next time your doctor asks about your symptoms, everything is right there on your phone.

BACK UP WHEN YOU WANT.
Upgrade to Premium to turn on automatic iCloud backup - your data goes to your personal iCloud, not ours. You can also save a backup file yourself and keep it anywhere you like.

Premium includes: automatic iCloud backup and manual export.

Log everything and use all reminders for free, forever.

Download Petals today. Track your cycle privately, in detail, on your own terms.

Privacy policy: https://prismtree.com/privacy-policy/
User license agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6825604929.description:
What Matters, at a Glance.

Your grocery list is buried in an app somewhere. Your seat and gate are in a booking screenshot. The code for the pickup locker is sitting in a text you can't find. When the moment comes, none of it is ever at hand.

Floaty keeps the next thing you need on your Lock Screen. No unlocking, no hunting through apps—just lift your phone to see it, and get it done right there.

ONE BOARD FOR EVERYTHING THAT MATTERS NOW

• To-dos: Your headline plus checklist progress; check items off as you go, and finishing the last one completes the whole to-do 
• Flights: Flight number, terminals, seat and gate in a clean, ticket-style layout—no more digging through booking screenshots 
• Train tickets: Train number, departure and arrival, seat and gate, all on one ticket-style card 
• Package & locker codes: Grouped by pickup place so you see every code at once—big and readable when you walk up

Tap through items right on the Lock Screen and mark them done with a tap. Finish one, and the next one floats into view.

AUTO-ADD FROM TEXTS, NOTIFICATIONS, AND EMAIL (PRO)

No more copying codes and trip details by hand. Shortcuts automations hand your texts, notifications, and emails to Floaty, and anything matching your templates automatically becomes a to-do, a trip, or a locker code on your Lock Screen—without opening the app just to look them up. The rules are yours: full-text and regex templates—you decide what gets recognized and what it turns into.

LOCK SCREEN, DYNAMIC ISLAND, HOME SCREEN, AND WATCH

• Live Activity: Your item stays on the Lock Screen; anything with a deadline or departure switches to a highlighted countdown in its final hour 
• Dynamic Island: Departure time, checklist progress, or your locker code in the compact view 
• Home Screen widget: Page through and complete items without opening the app 
• Apple Watch: A Smart Stack card you can check at a glance—and complete with a tap

SHOW BY TIME OR PLACE

• Show on the Lock Screen only after a time you set—for example, after 6 p.m. when you’re heading home 
• Show only near a place you choose—for example, when you’re close to the pickup point

LAYERED REMINDERS. THOROUGH, NEVER NAGGING.

• To-dos and pickup codes: Set a reminder time, a heads-up before the deadline, and a deadline alert, each on its own 
• Trips: Get reminded 15, 30, or 60 minutes before departure, and again at departure time 
• Overdue and departed items are flagged in red. Overdue to-dos and pickup codes can be pushed by 1, 3, or 8 hours, to the end of the day 1, 3, or 7 days out, or to any time you pick

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your data lives only on your device. Texts, notifications, and emails are recognized entirely on-device—no AI, no cloud processing, nothing uploaded to a server. No accounts. No ads. No tracking.

FLOATY PRO

Every type can be added manually for free, with full use of the Lock Screen board, Dynamic Island, Home Screen widgets, and reminders. Floaty Pro unlocks Auto-Add: automatic adding from texts, from notifications, from emails, and from your own Shortcuts automations. Subscriptions auto-renew and can be cancelled anytime in App Store subscription settings; the Lifetime option is a one-time purchase that unlocks Pro forever. By purchasing, you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

Stop hunting through apps for the one thing you need right now.

Download Floaty. Your essentials, at a glance.

Terms of Use: www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6825604711.releaseNotes: Family tree connections are easier to follow. Parent–child lines are straighter in multigenerational trees, with fewer bends around neighboring branches.
6825604711.description:
Keep the important days close to your family.

FamilyDay brings birthdays, anniversaries, milestones, and everyday family moments together. Connect people and occasions in a family tree, and invite family members to keep shared dates up to date.

PEOPLE AND THEIR IMPORTANT DAYS
Build a family tree, record relationships, and connect people with birthdays and anniversaries. Add a photo for a family member and see their age based on a linked birthday. Choose the person who represents you to view family relationships from your perspective.

LOOK AHEAD AND REMEMBER HOW FAR YOU'VE COME
Browse occasions as cards, a list, or a calendar. See the days until the next occasion and the time that has passed since the original date. Use repeating dates for regular celebrations or one-time entries for a special moment.

KEEP FAMILY DATES TOGETHER
Invite family through Apple iCloud to maintain family information and shared occasions. Keep personal occasions visible only to you, alongside the dates you choose to share.

IMPORTANT DAYS ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Add a FamilyDay widget to see upcoming occasions and family milestones at a glance.

MAKE TIME TO PREPARE
Set advance reminders with local notifications. Use Siri and Shortcuts to look up an occasion's next date, countdown, or elapsed days.

SAVE A MOMENT AS A LIVE PHOTO
Save an anniversary card as a Live Photo to your photo library, ready to keep or share.

START ON YOUR DEVICE, CHOOSE WHEN TO SYNC
New installations save on your device by default. Turn on iCloud Sync when you want to sync information across your own devices. No FamilyDay account, ads, or behavioral analytics. The developer does not collect your records. Apple iCloud provides cloud sync and family sharing.

FREE TRIAL AND LIFETIME ACCESS
Enjoy a 15-day free trial starting when you enter the app. The trial never charges automatically. After it ends, you can still view existing records, sync, and manage sharing. Adding or editing records, creating or joining a family, and inviting members require a one-time purchase for lifetime access. The App Store displays the price for your region.

Available in English and Simplified Chinese for iPhone and iPad.

iCloud sync and family sharing require an Apple Account with iCloud enabled. Reminders require notification permission, and saving a Live Photo requires permission to add photos. Siri and Shortcuts availability depends on your device, system, and language settings.

Terms of Use: https://familyday.ycstudio.cc/terms
Support email: ycstudio2031@gmail.com

6831184506.releaseNotes: Dayfetti 2.0 brings a cleaner look across iPhone and iPad, refreshed widgets, faster performance and new ways to save and protect your memories. Please update Dayfetti on all your devices, and thank you for using the app.
6831184506.description:
Count down to birthdays, trips, anniversaries and the days you look forward to. Keep your next date on a Home Screen widget, and when the day arrives, save photos and a few words so it becomes a memory you can look back on.

No account, no ads and no subscription.

Plan your dates
• Create all-day or timed countdowns, with live timers when the day gets close.
• Repeat daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or on your own custom schedule.
• Get reminders when you need them, and organize everything with categories and favorites.
• Import upcoming dates from Apple Calendar with search and filters.

Make each card yours
• Choose colors, original patterns, your own photos (cropped and zoomed to fit), symbols and emoji.
• Adjust text and countdown styles so every card stays easy to read in light or dark mode.
• Set a starting look for each category or personalize any card on its own.

Keep your memories
• Save photos and notes on any past day or repeating milestone without changing future dates.
• Past countdowns move into Moments automatically, and deleted cards stay recoverable for 30 days.
• Lock Moments on your device with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode with Dayfetti Pro.

Widgets and sharing
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets that follow your next date, a category, your favorites or a single event.
• Share any countdown as a clean picture card in free layouts. Private notes, to do lists and memories are never included automatically.

Free to use, with optional one-time Pro
Unlimited countdowns, iCloud sync, widgets, reminders, photos, Calendar import, backups and sharing are all free. Dayfetti Pro is a single one-time purchase (never a subscription) that adds Moments Lock, to do lists, unlimited custom categories, any color, the full pattern and symbol collections, and sharing without the Dayfetti mark.

Your data stays yours
No Dayfetti account and no ads. Your events, photos and memories stay on your devices and sync privately through your own iCloud account, with manual and automatic backups whenever you need them.
